lore: The quay tram has one wagon for every island in the census, and the night crew coupled them up in any old order. The outbound line must take them in number order. Shunter Rosalind has two dead-end sidings to work with. Only the wagon nearest the points can move, and nothing goes back onto the inbound line. Marshal the train in as few moves as you can.

lines.smart: Out in order and on par. The yardmaster won't believe the timesheet.
lines.slow: All out in order, but you worked the points more than you needed to. Plan the sidings first.
lines.jammed: Wagons still in the yard. Keep the small numbers on top of the sidings.
